hero.title: 🧑‍🌾 NPC Name Generator
hero.tagline: Instant townsfolk for your game: a name, a job and something to remember them by.

article.intro: Players always ask the name of the person you didn't plan for. This **NPC name generator** gives you a ready-made villager, merchant or guard in one click: a name that fits their race, what they do, and a quirk that makes them stick.

sections.heading: What makes a memorable NPC
sections.content:
A memorable NPC needs three things: a name that fits, a job, and one detail players will remember.

  • The name should suit their people: a dwarf called Udok Runemail, a halfling called Brimble Pottle, a tiefling with a virtue name like Trust or Resolve.
  • The job tells players why this person matters, or doesn't: a wigmaker, a chimney sweep, a candlemaker.
  • One quirk is enough. The D&D 5e Dungeon Master's Guide has tables of NPC mannerisms and traits for the same reason: a single habit, like mispronouncing every name, does more than a page of backstory.

sections.heading: Using it at the table
sections.content:
• Keep a list ready. Generate a batch before the session and tick names off as you use them, so the blacksmith keeps the same name next week.
  • Pick a format: name only for a quick answer, name and job for a crowd scene, or name, job and quirk for someone the party will talk to.
  • Choose a race to people a dwarven hold or an elven town, or leave it on Any for a busy market.
  • Need a letter? The Starts with option gives names beginning with any letter you choose.

For somewhere to put them, try the Tavern, Fantasy Town and Fantasy Shop name generators.

For every race and class, see all the D&D name generators.

faqs.question: How do I make an NPC quickly?
faqs.answer: Give them a name that fits their race, a job and one quirk. Choose the full format here for all three at once, like a suspicious chimney sweep who refuses to go out after dark.

faqs.question: What's a good name for a D&D NPC?
faqs.answer: One that fits their people: choose a race for names in that style, from human and elf to dwarf, halfling, gnome, half-orc and tiefling.

faqs.question: Can I get NPC names that start with a certain letter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Starts with option to pick a letter. It ignores titles, so names are matched on the name itself.
